item.title: URGENT – Footpath obstruction STILL NOT FIXED despite being marked resolved twice, 1st September
item.description:
URGENT – Footpath obstruction STILL NOT FIXED despite being marked resolved twice I am reporting this issue again because, for the second time, I have been informed that the problem has been fixed when it quite clearly has not. The vegetation from the playing fields is still significantly obstructing the public footpath, forcing pedestrians towards the kerb and potentially into a live road to get past. I originally reported this because I witnessed a mother and young child having difficulty safely using this section of pavement. This remains a genuine pedestrian safety issue. I would therefore like to know why this issue keeps being marked as fixed when the obstruction remains in place. Please arrange for somebody to inspect the location and ensure the vegetation is properly cut back so that the full usable width of the pavement is restored. Please do not close this report as resolved until the work has actually been completed. As this is now a repeated failure to resolve a reported safety issue, if it is closed again without the work being carried out, I will raise it through the council’s formal complaints procedure.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Swingate Lane, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
